description: The IBAN rules for a single country: how many characters its IBANs run to, whether the country is in SEPA, and whether its IBANs are approved for international use. It describes a country, never a particular IBAN - use validate_iban to check one of those, and list_supported_countries to see every country at once rather than calling this in a loop. A well-formed code we hold no format for comes back as a stated refusal naming the code, so a country can safely be asked about on spec. Requires an X-Api-Key header but costs no allowance.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. DE. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored. This is the country of the IBAN, which is the first two characters of the IBAN itself - not the country the bank is headquartered in, and not a currency or dialling code.

name: get_country_iban_format
title: IBAN format for one country
